How do I find my tracking link?
Here are the easiest ways to find your tracking link:
Check your email: We send a “Your order is on its way” email with a tracking link as soon as your parcel ships (usually the evening before delivery). Look in Spam/Junk and search for “Bloom & Wild” or your order number.
Your account: Log in to your Bloom & Wild account > My orders > select the order > Track delivery.
App (if you use it): Open the order in the app; you’ll see the tracking link and any courier updates.
SMS: If you opted in to texts at checkout, DPD/Royal Mail may also text you a tracking link on the day.

My tracking says delivered but I didn't receive it, what now?
I’m sorry this has happened—let’s sort it out. First, a few quick checks that often locate a “delivered” parcel:
Check the tracking page for any delivery photo or notes (e.g., left in a safe place or with a neighbour).
Look around common safe spots: porches, behind bins, inside meter/utility cupboards, sheds, or parcel lockers/boxes.
Ask neighbours, building reception/concierge, or check a communal mail/parcel room if applicable.
Double‑check the delivery address on your order and your doorbell/letterbox name matches the label.
Give it a short while: occasionally a driver marks delivered just before dropping off, and it arrives shortly after.
If it’s still missing, I can investigate with the courier right away. Please share:
The delivery postcode
Any details you see on the tracking (photo/notes) and anything you’ve already checked
Once I have that, I’ll look into it and help with the next steps.

Can I reroute the package to a different address?
Short answer: full address changes aren’t usually possible once an order has shipped. Here’s how it works and what we can do:
If the order hasn’t dispatched yet: We may be able to update the address (or cancel and reorder) before it’s packed. Share your order number, the delivery postcode, and the new address and I’ll check right away.
If it has already shipped: We can’t reroute it to a different address. However:
DPD: Using the tracking link/app, you can often change the delivery day, choose a DPD Pickup shop, or ask to leave with a neighbour/safe place. Full address changes aren’t supported.
Royal Mail: Address reroutes aren’t available once in transit. If delivery can’t be made, it’s usually held at the local delivery office or returned to sender.
If you’d like, I can check your order’s current status and what options are available. Please share:
(If trying before dispatch) the new address you want
If changing the address isn’t possible but you just need it another day, I can try to move the delivery date instead—tell me the new date you’d like.
